Made with Natural Earth. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
Public-domain Natural Earth 1:110m present-day country boundaries, excluding Antarctica.
Source terms https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
The bundled SVG is a simplified equirectangular rendering derived from the project geography.
Coordinates in countries.csv are approximate display locations, not aid project locations.
All aid amounts and their connection to these countries are fictional teaching data.
